name: Jose Vega
headline: Education and AI
summary:
I am an Education Sciences PhD candidate with a masters in Artificial Intelligence. I specialize in rethinking traditional educational to facilitate the ethical integration of technology in the classroom. Driven to shape the future of learning through evidence-based innovation.

🧠 More by accident then by design, I have studied cognitive systems from multiple perspectives: biological, technical and human (psychological). My current fascination lies in the human ability to learn.
🚀 Empowering the innovators of tomorrow at CDTM – Europe's leading study program for innovation and entrepreneurship.
🌈 Passionate about DE&I education in academic and professional institutions. I strongly believe that education is our best weapon to fight systematic injustice.

positions.title: Management Team
positions.company: Center for Digital Technology and Management (CDTM)
positions.description:
-Co-Directed Europe’s leading entrepreneurship program, achieving the world’s #1 unicorn-per-capita ratio and managing an alumni network with €1B+ funding.
-Curated annual cohorts of engineers, MBAs, and technical founders through a highly selective process (5% acceptance rate) for the entrepreneurship program.
-Led a 3-year competency mapping initiative: defined 35 competencies, designed a multi-method validation process, and published a construct map that became the architectural foundation for an overhauled 200+ hour curriculum
-Developed 5 new educational formats and standardized frameworks, enabling the next gen. of facilitators to maintain and scale complex learning experiences.
-Co-led international expansion into Spain, securing a 10-year government deal and raising €200k in internal community funds to establish the Valencia hub.
-Steered a 1,000-user IT infrastructure transition, navigating stringent German data privacy constraints to achieve organization-wide adoption and compliance.

positions.title: Product Developement and Fulfillment Manager

company.name: Center for Digital Technology and Management (CDTM)
company.tagline: Connect, Educate and Empower the Innovators of Tomorrow
company.description:
The Center for Digital Technology and Management (CDTM), a joint institution of the Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München (LMU) and the Technische Universität München (TUM), offers talented students the international and interdisciplinary study program Technology Management. 

The CDTM focuses on how to manage High-Tech in close cooperation with industry, research and education, while simultaneously being committed to preparing the students for future leadership positions in their professional career.
